original_benchmark.notes: Hugging Face futurehouse/ether0-benchmark (test split, revision c7d5e59960087f360bc32a5006bb994324b38c35). The published baseline prompts an LLM directly with ether0's LOOSE_XML_ANSWER_USER_PROMPT and scores the extracted <answer> with ether0's reward functions (Future-House/ether0 @ b77e0d8eb06f62c8528da72bff22d4c7fee11371). 75 of the 325 problems (molecule-completion, oracle-solubility, retro-synthesis) do not ship a reference answer and are not adapted.
